subject: Graduate civil engineer enquiry, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Breese Pitt Dixon team,

Your careers page says you are keen to hear from graduate civil engineers and asks for an introduction with a CV, so this is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

The work I am looking for is civil design for land development: the estate roads, drainage and retarding basins your engineers design. My software experience is from study, not commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil design role, now or later?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: Your careers page invites graduate civil engineers to send an introduction and CV, so this is a speculative enquiry about a graduate civil engineering or civil design role with your team in Hawthorn East.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records.

Estate roads, drainage and retarding basins are the civil design work I want to build a career in, and learning from Directors who work on every project, as your page describes, is a real draw. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My software experience is from study rather than commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about any graduate opening, now or later.

checklist: Confirm info@bpd.com.au is still the expressions of interest address on https://www.bpd.com.au/careers

Send only when sending is re-enabled and Marc approves (one email per run)
